nuggets.text: Aggies coach Bronco Mendenhall has players earn their jersey numbers each season through a player-managed system.
Aggies coach Bronco Mendenhall's brother, Mat, started at defensive end for the Washington Redskins in Super Bowl XVII.
Aggies QB McCae Hillstead started for Utah State as a true freshman in 2023, transferred to BYU, then came back.
Aggies receiver Anthony Garcia threw four touchdown passes on just seven attempts last season.
The Aggies and Utah first played on Nov. 25, 1892, in Logan, and the Aggies won 12-0.
The Aggies' Maverik Stadium sits 4,710 feet above sea level.
Saturday is the Aggies' fourth trip to Seattle to play the Huskies, after visits in 1904, 1998 and 2015.
Aggies great Merlin Olsen won the 1961 Outland Trophy, and the Aggies' home field is named for him.
Aggies coach Bronco Mendenhall has been a head coach at four schools: BYU, Virginia, New Mexico and Utah State.
The Aggies are in their first Pac-12 season after 13 years in the Mountain West.
